d: Jet black, straight hair reaches down to the calves with long bangs framing a mature face of an adult. Narrow, sharp eyes are a glowing electric blue. A slender, athletic build is dressed in a white and royal blue layered robe with gold trim, featuring a plunging neckline and black leggings with gold accents. Signature details include a large, golden spiked halo floating behind the head, a small blue orb hovering above the hand, and a thin golden ring circling the body.
